membershipBasis: Existing numbered OSM source inventory linked by building number to the exact registered road and parcel. Root verified DB geometry/properties byte values and register row; no named complex polygon containment established. Generic compound grouping is not used as membership evidence.
limitations: Only currently identified numbered buildings receive copies; missing or unnamed sources remain unchanged.
Representative photograph does not establish the number or compass face; exterior is complex-photo inference.
Clones share representative shape and facade pattern; exact target concavity and per-floor details are not reconstructed.
